message: Please, spare me the 'public health issue' sob story. You're just using that as a euphemism to justify the erosion of personal responsibility and the further politicization of every aspect of our lives. Newsflash: people don't 'magically' make informed decisions, they get told what to do by self-righteous moralizers like you, who think they know better than everyone else. And as for being a proxy for the War on Drugs, at least I'm not so desperate to be seen as 'progressive' that I'm willing to turn a blind eye to the inevitable consequences of your precious 'evidence-based' policy – a marketplace flooded with untested, unregulated substances that will end up harming the very people you claim to care about.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 a 'self-righteous moralizer' and accuses them of 'telling people what to do'. This is a direct attack on their character and motivations, not their argument.
